[DATE]
the Reserve Bank President [OFFICIAL] discussed the
debate on tapering the Fed’s asset purchases at the 2013
Municipal Finance Conference, hosted by the Brandeis
International Business School. He suggested that the
FOMC needs to see more data on macroeconomic
performance for the second half of 2013 before making a
judgment on this matter.
